request.system:
You write a short brief for an account owner in Sales at Lumen Labs. A signal has fired on one of their accounts, and they will decide whether and how to reach out. They have two minutes and have not looked at this account recently.

You are given a JSON object of facts about the account. Use only those facts. Every number you write must appear in the facts exactly as given: do not round, add, subtract, estimate or convert. If a fact is missing or null, leave it out. Do not guess at reasons the data does not show.

Write five short lines, in this order, each starting with its label:

Signal: what fired, in plain words.
Evidence: the two or three facts that matter most for this signal.
Likely need: what the customer probably needs (more seats, or the next edition), and why the evidence points there.
Suggested opener: one sentence the account owner could say or write to the customer. Helpful, not pushy.
Risks: anything in the facts that argues for caution (open high-priority tickets, a low NPS score, yellow or red health, a renewal close by). Write "none visible in the data" if there is nothing.

Plain text, no headings, no bullet symbols.

messages.content: {"account_name": "Merium Energy", "segment": "smb", "edition": "standard", "next_edition": "premium", "arr": 1709, "seats_licensed": 20, "seats_assigned": 19, "seats_assigned_30_days_ago": 17, "seat_utilisation_pct": 95, "monthly_active_users": 15, "automation_rules": 12, "automation_rule_limit": 15, "integrations": 0, "integration_limit": 3, "assist_credits_used_30d": 0, "assist_credits_included": 200, "health_score": 80.6, "health_band": "green", "open_high_priority_tickets": 0, "latest_nps_score": 9, "days_to_renewal": 238, "trigger_signal": "seat_pressure", "trigger_evidence": "19 of 20 seats assigned", "expansion_score_pct": 58, "expansion_reasons": "nearly all seats assigned, near the automation limit, most seats active"}

content.text:
Signal: Seat pressure. Merium Energy has assigned 19 of its 20 licensed seats, up from 17 thirty days ago, so the account is almost out of seats.

Evidence: Seat utilisation is 95 percent (19 assigned of 20 licensed). Seats assigned rose from 17 to 19 in 30 days. Automation rules are at 12 of a 15 limit, and the account has 0 of 3 integrations in use.

Likely need: More seats is the nearest need, since the account can add only one more user before it is full and assignments grew by two in a month. Automation use at 12 of 15 suggests the team is building workflows, so a seat top-up or a conversation about Premium's higher automation and integration headroom would fit. The data does not show whether Premium is a fit, so treat it as a question to explore.

Suggested opener: "Hi, I noticed your team has nearly filled its 20 seats and is growing, so I wanted to check whether you need more seats before you run short."

Risks: Assist credits show 0 of 200 used in the last 30 days, and integrations are 0 of 3, so adoption of some included features is low. Health is green at 80.6, NPS is 9, and there are no open high-priority tickets. Renewal is 238 days away.
